salary_details.details: The consolidated monthly pay for each post is given in the Vacancy table above (ranging from ₹41,190 to ₹78,390, depending on the post and experience slab). In addition, the following benefits apply: | Site/Metro Allowance: 7.5% of pay as Site Allowance for postings at site/project locations, or 2.5% of pay as Metro Allowance for postings at Metro locations. Annual Increment: 3% of consolidated pay (rounded to the next ten rupees), as per company rules. Medical Facilities: OPD/IPD coverage (including medicine) at Ispat Hospital for self, spouse, and 2 dependent children if posted at Ranchi; free consultation via the company's retainer doctor at other locations; reimbursement of annual Mediclaim premium up to ₹15,000 (₹4,00,000 floater cover) as per company policy. Accommodation: Company/client residential accommodation where available, on prevailing charges; if not availed, House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 5% of consolidated pay. Leave: 12 days Casual Leave, 18 days Earned Leave (accumulable up to 45 days), 14 days Half Pay Leave, and Maternity Leave as applicable to regular employees, plus National/Festival/Restricted Holidays (4 nos.) as applicable to regular employees. Group Personal Accident Policy: Sum insured of ₹25 lakhs.

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must apply online only, via Careers → Career Opportunities → Apply Online on MECON's website (meconlimited.co.in), between 3 October 2026 and 17 October 2026. No other mode of submission is allowed. While applying, candidates must upload:
A recent passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG format, maximum 40 KB).
A scanned signature in blue/black ink (JPG/JPEG format, maximum 40 KB).

Self-attested scanned copies (PDF format) of: Matriculation/Secondary Board certificate or Municipal birth certificate (for age proof); final/provisional Graduation and Post-Graduation certificates, as applicable; all semester/year mark sheets or a consolidated mark sheet; work experience certificates/documents as described in the Eligibility section; PAN Card and Aadhaar Card; PwD certificate (if applicable); EWS Income & Asset Certificate (if applicable); Discharge/Service Certificate for Ex-servicemen (if applicable); J&K domicile certificate (if applicable); and Meritorious Sportsperson certificate (if applicable).

All documents must be legible, self-attested, and not encrypted/password-protected. Multiple documents should be merged into a single PDF not exceeding 1 MB. If the Aadhaar number entered online does not match the uploaded Aadhaar card, the application will be summarily rejected. No modifications are allowed after the online application is submitted, so candidates should verify all details carefully before submitting.
important_instructions: Candidates employed in Central/State Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must either forward their application through proper channel, or produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer at the time of interview; without this, they will neither be interviewed nor paid TA. All original certificates/documents must be produced before the interview; failure to do so means the candidate will neither be interviewed nor paid TA. Furnishing wrong/false information, or producing overwritten/illegible documents, will lead to disqualification; if discovered at any stage (including after appointment), the candidature or offer of appointment will be cancelled. No hard copies of documents need to be sent; however, a hard copy of the online application must be submitted at the time of interview, if called. Candidates not shortlisted for interview, or not selected, will not be individually communicated about the status of their candidature. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. Candidates must have an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least the next one year, as no change is allowed after submission and all communication is via email only. Mere submission of an application and fulfilling eligibility criteria confers no right to employment; MECON reserves the right to alter advertised conditions, or to fill, not fill, or partially fill any vacancy, without assigning reasons. Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Ranchi (Jharkhand) only. For queries, candidates may email [email protected] or call 0651-2483571/2483043, between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM on working days (Monday to Saturday, excluding 2nd and 4th Saturdays).

content_sections.heading: MECON FTFT Selection Process
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is Personal Interview (subject to change at Management's discretion). Candidates should ensure they meet all eligibility criteria before applying, since candidature is subject to verification of documents when reporting for interview, if shortlisted, or at any later stage of the recruitment/appointment process. The list of candidates called for interview, along with date, time, and venue, will be uploaded on MECON's official website and communicated to shortlisted candidates via their registered email. The final list of selected candidates will also be published on MECON's website, and selected candidates will be informed about Document Verification and Medical Examination through the website and registered email only. Scrutiny of the application is undertaken on the date of the interview; if any claim made in the application is not substantiated, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for interview, and no Travelling Allowance (TA) will be paid. Before appointment, selected candidates must undergo a Medical Examination and be found medically fit; joining is subject to this outcome. Outstation candidates appearing for the Personal Interview are reimbursed Travelling Allowance for III Tier A/C (3A)/CC by rail, or ₹7 per km by road, or actual expenditure, whichever is less, subject to production of tickets/receipts/boarding pass (regular rail fare only, no premium Tatkal). Internal candidates are governed by the company's service rules.

faq.question: Q1. What is MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. 2026/Cont/04 from MECON Limited, inviting applications for 159 posts of experienced professionals across 59 post codes, for engagement on a Full Time Fixed Tenure (contractual) basis for 1 to 5 years.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 159 posts across 59 post codes, spanning disciplines such as Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Planning, Quality, Safety, Mining, Environmental Engineering, and Contracts. See the Vacancy section above for the complete post-wise breakup.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closing date is 17 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MECON FTFT posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post code - mostly a B.E/B.Tech in the relevant engineering discipline, with some posts accepting a Diploma plus certification, or an M.Sc in a relevant science subject. See the Vacancy table above for the exact qualification for each post code.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is predominantly 50 years for General/EWS candidates, as on the cut-off date of 25 September 2026, with age relaxation available for OBC, SC/ST, PwD, J&K domicile, and Ex-servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the MECON FTFT application fee?
faq.answer: ₹500 (non-refundable) for UR/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EWS candidates; SC/ST/PwD/Ex-servicemen and internal candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only at meconlimited.co.in (Careers → Career Opportunities → Apply Online) between 3 October 2026 and 17 October 2026, as described in the How to Apply section above.

faq.question: Q8. What is the MECON FTFT selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Personal Interview, subject to prior document verification; the list of shortlisted and selected candidates is published on MECON's website and communicated via registered email.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for MECON FTFT posts?
faq.answer: Consolidated monthly pay ranges from ₹41,190 to ₹78,390 depending on the post and experience slab, in addition to Site/Metro Allowance, annual increment, medical facilities, accommodation/HRA, leave, and a Group Personal Accident Policy. See the Salary & Benefits section above for full details.
